verdict.rationale: Fireworks AI is an inference and fine-tuning platform, not an agent, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair question and the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents a first-party MCP server or hosted MCP endpoint. Tool calling, OpenAI-compatible APIs, Nexus CLI, the REST API/OpenAPI spec and llms.txt are adjacent features or developer building blocks and earn no credit for this story.
